conventions.LR_primary: LR is exact normalized TDM hit before numeric conversion. Finite-result nonempty-board rate is separately reported. No >=3 prediction filter is added.
conventions.AO: (1/k) sum_{d=1..k} |G[:d] intersect M[:d]| / d, k=min(lengths); elements are paper IDs
conventions.AO_empty: Zero when k=0; all target gold boards remain in macro denominator
conventions.AO_ties: Sort Result using official metric direction, then paper_id ascending; no dense or fractional ranks
conventions.numeric_conversion: Unmodified official constructor; duplicate (TDM,paper) uses last valid convertible tuple in original input order
conventions.RBO_signature: (self, k: Optional[float] = None, p: float = 1.0, ext: bool = False) -> float
conventions.RBO_caveat: Official rbo() default p=1 is unweighted overlap over deduplicated result-value rankings. Supplementary AO uses distinct paper IDs, retaining tied papers.
